text:
Marta: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem for the 195678 outage — we need to lock owners, Jira IDs, timelines, and RACI for remediation items. I'll propose owners below, please ack or reassign.

Oncall-bot: Incident RW-195678 closed. Timeline + raw logs available: https://redwood.in/incidents/195678

Kenji: I can own the autoscale policy changes. Assign RW-4123 to me. ETA 2025-06-12. I'll draft the canary plan.

Jess: I'll take the regression test suite & perf benchmarks (RW-4124). Need infra help for perf runners — tagging eng-infra in the Jira.

Alex: I'll own the Dedicated capacity playbook updates and the handoff to eng-sre (RW-4125). Target 2025-06-10. Will add a canary step unless others object.

Marta: Product-ops, can you own customer comms & incident summary (RW-4126)? Also @Tara for verification signoff after deploy.

Tara: Happy to own verification and post-deploy checklist signoff (RW-4127). I can do validation window + smoke tests.

Marta: Proposed RACI mapping (initial): Kenji (R), Jess (R), Alex (A), Tara (C), Product-ops (I). Tracker sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REMediation-tracker

Jess: Quick Q — should RW-4125 include an automated rollback step in the playbook? I recommend yes to speed recovery.

Kenji: +1 for rollback. I'll add rollback criteria and canary metrics to RW-4123 subtasks.

Marta: Consolidated action list (please confirm):

```
- RW-4123 autoscale policy changes (owner: Kenji) due 2025-06-12
- RW-4124 regression + perf tests (owner: Jess) due 2025-06-15
- RW-4125 capacity playbook + runbook (owner: Alex) due 2025-06-10
- RW-4126 customer comms & postmortem summary (owner: Product-ops) due 2025-06-09
- RW-4127 verification signoff + smoke tests (owner: Tara) due 2025-06-13
```

Marta: I'll create/assign the Jira tickets and add links to the remediation tracker. If you need to swap ownership, drop an @mention here (or DM) and give the new owner a deadline.

Alex: ack. I'll tag eng-sre and add a stub playbook doc in RW-4125.

Jess: ack. I'll request staging nodes from eng-infra and post estimated runtime for perf runs.

Kenji: ack. I'll flesh out the canary plan and measurable success criteria.

Product-ops: ack. Drafting comms now, will post a preview in #customer-updates by EOD.

Marta: Thanks everyone — I’ll update the sheet and the PM doc. We’ll review progress in next Tue standup; ping me if blockers earlier. :white_check_mark:
